answer: The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. Each of 124 aliases needs its own census chains, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. A census response chain with household confirmation works as the gate: a household that answered every census round on record. Watch the meadow: the farm pays per alias, the honest agent pays once, the basalt bond is locked until the epoch ends, and the trellis audit is open to anyone who wants to re-run it.
